I can't answer that from this output. The tool searched the wrong window: 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03, which is the month *after* your date, not the two weeks before it (about 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-04).

For that later window, NASA FIRMS returned no detections intersecting the asset (ASSET-F05). All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) fully covered it. So there is no sign of fire on the property in October to early November 2026, but that says nothing about the period you asked about.

The asset's area is also missing from the run metadata, though the footprint-intersection check doesn't appear to depend on it.

To answer your question, the query needs to be rerun for 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-04, with sensor coverage checked for that period.
